digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and model configuration
propositions: infer_provider('gemini-2.5-pro') maps to 'google_genai', which is not recognized by either _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders, causing provider construction to fail at call time
bare gemini-* model ids are unusable via the model-class/ladder path (model_classes._resolve_target) because the inferred provider name google_genai is verbatim and unresolvable
pydantic-ai 1.107.1 recognizes 'google' as the canonical provider for Gemini Developer API, not 'google_genai'
mapping gemini prefix to 'google' instead of 'google_genai' resolves the defect while maintaining compatibility with pydantic-ai's current known providers
the inference table must guarantee all mapped provider names exist in _pydantic_ai_known_providers() or ProviderSession._builders to prevent future defects
